summary.text: One of the earthborn Giants whom Apollo shot in the left eye and Heracles in the right during the Gigantomachy.

story.text: Apollodorus names Ephialtes among the Giants destroyed when Heracles fought at the gods' side: Apollo shot him with an arrow in his left eye and Heracles in his right. The collective node `gigantes` holds the oracle that required a mortal's help; this node is the individual in the battle roster.
The atlas keeps this Ephialtes distinct from `ephialtes-aload`, the Aload who with his brother Otus piled Ossa on Olympus.
